failure_condition: A focusable button is inside an aria-hidden subtree.
interaction_steps: Tab through the page and inspect whether the hidden button is exposed in the Accessibility Tree.
expected_outcome: No focusable control should be simultaneously hidden from assistive technology.
manual_verification_method: Keyboard-test focus and inspect the accessibility representation of the hidden subtree.
dom_testability: Testable by detecting a focusable descendant of aria-hidden=true.
accessibility_tree_testability: The tree may omit aria-hidden ancestry and can even expose a currently focused descendant; such exposure alone cannot prove that the control was in an aria-hidden subtree.
limitations: The ACT rule specifically tests sequentially focusable descendants. A static tree node marked focusable does not alone prove sequential focus; this fixture also runs a keyboard tab sequence.
